cues: A group is a set with an operation satisfying four axioms.
An identity element that changes nothing.
And an inverse for every element that brings it back to the identity.
If the order of combining never matters, the group is abelian.
Its order is the number of elements.
text: A group is a set with an operation satisfying four axioms. Closure. Associativity. An identity element that changes nothing. And an inverse for every element that brings it back to the identity. If the order of combining never matters, the group is abelian. Its order is the number of elements.
